adj.description: Adjacency matrix: $1$ if location $a$ is adjacent to $a'$, $0$ otherwise

r.description: Reward earned for a flight being at location $a$ in time period $t$

cap.description: Capacity of sector $a$ in time period $t$

notes: We identify a number of modeling inconsistencies in the original pair of formulations. To address this, we propose a new pair of flow-based formulations. The efficient formulation `p13.a` is an aggregated version of `p13.b`.

The problem is not NP-hard: interchangeable flights are aggregated into a single commodity, and the location capacities are node capacities on a time-expanded flow network, so the constraint matrix is totally unimodular. The per-flight variant of the TFMP, in which each flight is its own commodity sharing the location capacities, is NP-hard.
